title: Reopen GitHub-backed stories and invalidate dependent completion
goal: Keep backlog and release rollups truthful when a previously closed GitHub issue reopens.
in_scope: Move any linked done story to in_progress when its mirrored GitHub issue is OPEN
Recompute direct and transitive blocked_by state after tracker updates
Prevent done dependents from remaining complete while any prerequisite is not done
Add regression fixtures for reopened issues and dependency chains
out_of_scope: Calling the GitHub API directly from sync-status.mjs
Deleting prior verify evidence when status reopens
acceptance: When a linked GitHub issue state changes from CLOSED to OPEN, sync-status.mjs moves its story from done to in_progress and recomputes dependency state so any story, including a previously done dependent, cannot remain complete while a blocked_by prerequisite is open.
invariants: GitHub issue state remains authoritative in GitHub tracker mode
No done story may depend on a non-done story after synchronization
Existing verification evidence is preserved for audit while current status reflects reopened work
